label: Willing a creature's existence: as a good to that recipient, or as ordered to others
resolution: Two readings of the q.19 a.4 / q.20 a.2 causal-willing step. CREATURE_WILLING_1 is recipient-directed willing (08b826db-2d9c-48e5-b69c-d4ac54088518). The registered route's CausalExistenceWilling (a94c5dfc-c722-49fe-a242-dd39409b079d) and the love results use only this reading. CREATURE_WILLING_2 is ordered willing (1ca75ad2-e6f6-492a-9fcc-19eebfc8d3aa). The q.20 a.2 ad 3 reading for irrational creatures is the weak sibling 7f6a2e91-4924-4488-8173-03d1dabb222b, which uses CREATURE_WILLING_2 alone. It is compatible with a94c5dfc at one willing relation (witness 5d93ac09-44cf-496f-a90e-84df7256521e). The strong sibling 1dd68893-7e41-4909-9f17-1dbb342a7d95 is an unattributed analyst variant: it adds the denial of CREATURE_WILLING_1 for distinct non-rational caused effects, relates both senses, and strengthens the weak sibling. With a94c5dfc it excludes any such effect (16fe393e-4983-45c4-9301-6b2421ae3649). Its arguments list it as their sense bridge. Only the weak sibling is the ad 3 reading. No registered love argument passes between the senses.
